d:
Gardanibag se rashtrapti bhavan tak: saiyad shah mehdi hasan ki anakhi kahani
Would you like a more dramatic or artistic version too?
Saiyad shah mehdi hasan ka janm bihar ke patna men huaa tha, valid ka nam saiyad shah muhammad hasan tha, jo bismil azimabadi ke nam se mashhur the. bare shayar the. bap ke fan ka asar bete men bhi aaya, islie saiyad shah mehdi hasan bhi sher o shayri karne lage. lekin unhonne jis fan men maqbuliyat paee vo unhen rashtrapti bhavan tak le gaee aur vo fan thi pentinga.
